description: Get the breadcrumb trail of a Sentry issue event: the navigation, console, HTTP, and user actions leading up to the error.

eventId.description: An event ID in the issue, or `latest`.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: get_issue_breadcrumbs

breadcrumbs.description: The trail of events leading up to the error, oldest first.

data.description: Compact JSON of the breadcrumb data, truncated after 200 characters.

title: Get Issue Breadcrumbs
